Subject: Aurora pilot onboarding — PO request and spend cap

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're ready to kick off the 3-month pilot and need a PO on file for procurement. High-level details: 

- Account: Aurora Cloud (Aurora Technologies, Inc.)
- Pilot start: Aug 1, 2026
- Requested spend cap: $25,000 USD (monthly cap preferred, but can do total pilot cap)
- Line items: 1) Inference compute (est. 70%), 2) Support and onboarding (est. 30%)
- Billing contact: accounts@auroracloud.com

I've attached our vendor onboarding form and a sample PO request spreadsheet that shows the line-item split we prefer. Can you confirm the PO issuance workflow, whether Redwood needs a specific purchase reference format, and how provisional PO numbers are issued for pilots?

Also let us know if you need our W-9 / tax paperwork up front.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Vega
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Aurora Cloud
(samantha.vega@auroracloud.com)

Subject: Re: Aurora pilot onboarding — PO request and spend cap

Samantha — thanks for the materials and clear breakdown. Looping in Procurement Ops (Laura) and Finance (Karthik) to route this for a provisional PO and spend-cap approval.

High-level from our side: we can issue a provisional PO reference immediately for onboarding and billing to begin; final PO number is generated once legal/procurement confirms tax docs and terms. For pilot-level spend caps we usually set a monthly threshold unless you request a fixed total.

Laura / Karthik — attached is Aurora's onboarding form and their requested split. Can you: 
- confirm the provisional PO ref we can issue for Aug 1 start
- confirm monthly vs total cap treatment (Aurora prefers monthly)
- flag any missing vendor docs (W-9, bank remittance)

I'll hold off on scheduling anything billing-facing until we have the provisional PO reference.

Thanks,
Mateo
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Mateo — reviewed Aurora's spreadsheet. A few items: 

1) Vendor docs: we need the completed onboarding form (they attached) plus either W-9 (US) or appropriate tax certificate. Ask them to send W-9.
2) Provisional PO: Procurement can issue a provisional reference RD-2026-07-001 for onboarding and initial invoices; final PO will be RD-PO-<sequential> once docs are in Hub and legal signs terms.
3) Spend cap treatment: we recommend monthly caps for pilots — safeguards against burst usage. We'll set monthly cap: $8,500/month (three months = $25,500) which is within the $25k requested; can adjust if Aurora wants the total locked instead.
4) Line items: we'll issue the PO with two line items and include suggested accounting codes. Please confirm their accounting center (cost center) so we tag invoices correctly. If they want a single lump-sum PO, let us know — that requires finance approval and changes to how we track usage.

Action items for Mateo: please request W-9 and confirm cost center. I'll prepare the provisional PO ref and attach RDW provisional PO stub.

Laura Bennett
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
